label: Exploratory; not a test of H1-H10. Seen creators only. Voice labels model-coded, not checked by a person; agreement, never accuracy.
agnosticism: No measure in this study can tell whether a non-human source speaks; every measure describes the speech in these recordings and how the creators present it.

published_copy.note: Every other SHA-256 in this file is the hash of the private file, as written in the private run folder (files under code/ and private/, and the step's shared folder, are not published). published_sha256 gives the SHA-256 of each published file as staged; it equals the hash of the private file except where a file is listed under changed_for_publication. Bytes are published unchanged (no line-ending conversion). status.json cannot list its own hash.
added_or_changed_for_publication: prespec-hash-record.md: byte-identical copy of the step's shared prespecification hash record, which status.json cites as ../common/prespec-hash-record.md
